irish_times.stop_reason: month_day_index_transport_stop; Official month index exposes day navigation; first 2025-07-01 index probe timed out in web tool. Source stopped; no direct-client retry. Print archive sign-in not accessed.

dw.stop_reason: robots_access_stop; Official domain returned a non-retryable robots restriction; current terms could not be read. Historic special-project imprint is limited evidence, not news licence.

guardian.stop_reason: rights_gate_no_new_scraping; Current official terms gate new acquisition. Historical environment archive and four diagnostic receipts are retained separately. API route starts 1999; 1995 print route is a separate licensed frame.

bbc.stop_reason: official_terms_robots_stop; Official terms route was robots-blocked in the web tool. News Online launched 1997; 1995 broadcasts are a different medium. No current article frame enumerated.

smh.stop_reason: official_access_probe_stop; Official robots/terms probes failed in web tool; no alternate transport attempted. National Library NZ lists SMH 1955–1995 archives as on-site access; this is not our entitlement.

abc.stop_reason: retired_archive_no_date_frame; Official old archive says no longer updated; guessed month route failed and is terminal. RSS discontinuation and licensed syndication are distinct routes; no article enumeration.

nyt.stop_reason: API_key_entitlement_not_established; Publisher GitHub Archive API documents monthly metadata from 1851 and requires a key. No configured entitlement established; credentials were not inspected; no API call. Full response size may exceed object cap.

npr.stop_reason: robots_access_stop; Official NPR host robots restriction is terminal. NPR CDS premium route requires partner agreement; none established. Member-reproduced NPR terms are explicitly an archival reproduction.

rnz.stop_reason: rights_gate_no_new_scraping; Official legal conditions gate new article/index acquisition. Schedule-data permissions do not establish news-text permissions.

note: NZ Herald publisher collection blocked by route policy. The allowlisted National Library catalogue probe uses a distinct lawful metadata route, never publisher article content.
